guard: PR pack and Changesets version/snapshot keep both native linux builders on needs, download both artifacts, and invoke the shared assembler
why: Assembler and runtime smokes cannot see a deleted needs edge or a removed download-artifact step.
Those are the edits that silently ship one arch. The mutations below are those edits, one per named cell.

mutations.name: PR pack drops the arm64 builder from needs
mutations.find:
seat-pack:
    name: seat pack (assembled)
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: [seat-native-linux-x64, seat-native-linux-arm64]
mutations.replace:
seat-pack:
    name: seat pack (assembled)
    timeout-minutes: 20
    needs: [seat-native-linux-x64]
mutations.expectRed: ci.yml seat-pack needs both native linux builders
mutations.cell: ci.yml seat-pack needs both native linux builders

mutations.name: PR pack stops downloading the arm64 artifact
mutations.find:
- uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: seat-native-linux-arm64
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/seat-native-linux-arm64
      - name: Assemble natives and pack
mutations.expectRed: ci.yml seat-pack downloads both native linux artifacts
mutations.cell: ci.yml seat-pack downloads both native linux artifacts

mutations.name: PR pack stops calling the shared pack assembler
mutations.expectRed: ci.yml seat-pack runs the shared seat pack assembler
mutations.cell: ci.yml seat-pack runs the shared seat pack assembler

mutations.name: Changesets version drops the arm64 builder from needs
mutations.find:
version:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.snapshot == ''
    needs: [seat-native-linux-x64, seat-native-linux-arm64]
mutations.expectRed: changesets.yml version needs both native linux builders
mutations.cell: changesets.yml version needs both native linux builders

mutations.name: Changesets version stops downloading the arm64 artifact
mutations.find:
- uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: seat-native-linux-arm64
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/seat-native-linux-arm64

      - name: Create versions and publish
mutations.expectRed: changesets.yml version downloads both native linux artifacts
mutations.cell: changesets.yml version downloads both native linux artifacts

mutations.name: Changesets version publish skips the shared assembler
mutations.expectRed: changesets.yml version publish path runs the shared assembler
mutations.cell: changesets.yml version publish path runs the shared assembler

mutations.name: Changesets snapshot drops the arm64 builder from needs
mutations.find:
snapshot:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.snapshot != ''
    needs: [seat-native-linux-x64, seat-native-linux-arm64]
mutations.expectRed: changesets.yml snapshot needs both native linux builders
mutations.cell: changesets.yml snapshot needs both native linux builders

mutations.name: Changesets snapshot stops downloading the arm64 artifact
mutations.find:
- uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: seat-native-linux-arm64
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/seat-native-linux-arm64

      - name: Version snapshot
mutations.expectRed: changesets.yml snapshot downloads both native linux artifacts
mutations.cell: changesets.yml snapshot downloads both native linux artifacts

mutations.name: Changesets snapshot stops calling the shared assembler
mutations.expectRed: changesets.yml snapshot runs the shared assembler
mutations.cell: changesets.yml snapshot runs the shared assembler
